session.title: TCAS-II co-design object for H67 event optical-flow SNN transformer
session.question: Which hardware-software co-design object can be a TCAS-II brief: spike-driven Q-K optical flow, AEE at most 1.259, circuit face measurable on TSMC 28HPC+?
conflicts_or_power_dynamics: P02 originated most ideas; P03 is a same-model non-originator role, not an independent lab.
P01 forbade picking a paper title before screening; D001 selects a measurement next action only.
Facilitator drafted D001; owner has not signed.
session.skill_citation: Kassis, T., Agarwal, V., He, Y., Patel, D., & Brueckner, A. M. (2026). Scientific Agent Skills: A Library of Procedural Knowledge for Research Agents. arXiv:2609.00065. https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2609.00065

scope.purpose: Choose the next measurement, not a paper title.
scope.audience: P01 and the Codex implementation agent
in_scope: C1/C2 retry, new islands, network swap

constraints.statement: must remain SNN Transformer plus spike-driven Q-K
one A800 for a full valid825
no kill-list auto-drop of old C1/C2
one TCAS-II object with algorithm and circuit faces
score-leaf share under about 2 percent means I001 is not the circuit face
historical attention share ~0.59 percent still holds on ep34

current_knowledge: ep35 QK census token skip ~56 percent, window-clean ~9.9 percent
unresolved_observations: whether XOR term is required for AEE
prohibited_outputs: ep35 census pasted as ep34 tables

workflow.method_or_deviation: Grill-me contract copied; constraints classified real/assumed/negotiable/unknown.
Single-agent stand-in; examples existed (grill, 32 cards, priors). Origin labeled. Predictions are idea-specific in this rebuild.
No second human. SHARE.md records missing/contradiction/less-obvious.
Declared relations; I002 merged into I001; I013 split from I001.
criteria.json frozen before scores.csv; weights proposed by P02, unsigned by P01.
evaluate_matrix.py; decision left null. Single rater P02.
P03 same-model role; full templates for I001-I005, I007, I012.
Bounded 2024+ search then reopen I009-I013. Not Web of Science.
Digital 28nm OF accelerator; unpublished traces local; no human subjects.
D001 proposed by P02, unsigned by P01. next_action simulation M0-M2.

ideas.statement: Motion-XOR 32-lane triple-popcount score leaf with K_peer shadow.
predicted_observations: Equal-resource MX3P versus FireFly-T-style AND-PopCount on the same 32-lane issue width will spend extra cycles on the temporal XOR popcount.
If ep34 T0 score-leaf share is under about 2 percent, whole-net FPS delta from replacing the software Q7 with the leaf is consistent with zero at the reported precision.
uncertainties: ep34 attention score-leaf share T0 is unmeasured
whether the XOR term is accuracy-necessary is untested (I003)
disconfirming_evidence: T0 leaf share <2 percent and I003 one-block swap holds subset AEE

ideas.statement: Token-level skip of that leaf when K is zero both timesteps or Q/K are clean versus t0.
predicted_observations: On packed Q/K with the ep35 schema, token leaf_needed stays in 0.4-0.6 and 15x15 window fully-clean stays under 0.15.
If the Shiftmax denominator grain is the 15x15 window, lossless skip fraction equals window-clean, not token-skip.
uncertainties: RTL Shiftmax row is not yet aligned to token or 15x15
ep34 packed Q/K is not on disk
disconfirming_evidence: M2 row dirty approximately 100 percent on ep34

ideas.statement: Replace one stage-2 block Motion-XOR with published SDSA or QKFormer linear Q-K.
predicted_observations: Frozen-weight one-block swap moves subset AEE toward public SDformerFlow 1.58 unless a 10-frame finetune pulls it back.
If subset AEE stays at or below ep34 plus a small delta after 10 frames, the XOR term is not necessary for this probe.
uncertainties: Finetune budget needed to hold AEE 1.259 is unknown
QKFormer is a classification kernel, not an OF kernel
disconfirming_evidence: 10-frame AEE after one-block swap exceeds 1.259 directionally toward 1.58

ideas.statement: Mixed-horizon T=2/T=10 FC join: LoAS FTP as baseline, bounded temporal shared-sum as candidate.
predicted_observations: Equal-resource timeline versus direct FTP, including persist-Y and back-pressure, will not match the previously reported add reduction of 20.8/42.2 percent.
A uniform-T=10 LoAS pack of this net is illegal or occupancy-wasteful because attention fibers are T=2.
uncertainties: Whether mixed-T packing is a large enough delta for a TCAS-II title
Chen/Chang 28nm mux T=4/2/1 is a mixed-T prior
disconfirming_evidence: M4 equal-resource cycle ratio versus FTP at most 1.00

ideas.statement: TSBG B8 same-IO weight-row broadcast on frozen ep34 FC traces.
predicted_observations: Equal-resource RTL versus an LRU row buffer will not reproduce the CPU serialized 3.89x.
If cycle speedup is under 1.15x and weight-byte reduction is under 30 percent, the M3 gate fails.
uncertainties: RTL versus CPU gap size
owner previously judged the broadcast family unoriginal
disconfirming_evidence: M3 cycle ratio under 1.15 with byte reduction under 30 percent

ideas.statement: Copy Prosperity product forest onto H67 conv with optional ep34-PAFT.
predicted_observations: Official-model product/bit on the H67 conv layer stays near the already measured 2.33x.
Dual-port SRAM will not raise throughput if memory stall remains approximately 0.
uncertainties: Title novelty after naming Prosperity HPCA 2025
disconfirming_evidence: Independent novelty check after naming Prosperity fails

ideas.statement: Keep ATLIF membrane inside a mixed-T island; late-BN theta packet at the boundary.
predicted_observations: On real BN/PSN intervals, the existing A8 packet recovers membrane state with a measurable residual error.
Synthetic testbench intervals overstate recovery relative to online BN.
uncertainties: Real BN interval traces are not yet attached
first-mixed-T-ASIC claim is false given Chen/Chang
disconfirming_evidence: Recovery error on real intervals moves AEE past 1.259

ideas.statement: Sparse ConvTranspose decoder island with a complete Table-A.
predicted_observations: A closed D0/D2/D3 Table-A will show ConvTranspose share comparable to the historical ~22 percent envelope.
Without Table-A, any decoder speedup is not a co-design object.
uncertainties: m1681 shards are not Table-A
disconfirming_evidence: Closed table shows decoder share too small to justify an island

ideas.statement: Byte-level SRAM permute for T x 15 x 15 attention layout, FireFly-T style.
predicted_observations: Mapping FireFly-T byte-write permute onto TS1N28 1RW or 2RW macros is either legal or rejected by the foundry compiler.
uncertainties: Foundry compiler legalization unknown
disconfirming_evidence: Compiler rejects byte-write on the chosen macro

ideas.statement: Lateral-inhibition training on Motion-XOR co-silence, SpiLiFormer-style.
predicted_observations: A same_zero regularizer changes the co-silence histogram; if AEE and fire rate do not move, the training-only face is empty for this brief.
uncertainties: SpiLiFormer is classification, not optical flow
no circuit face for a 5-page hardware brief
disconfirming_evidence: AEE and same_zero histogram unchanged after the regularizer

predicted_observations: Running-BN inference on ep34 either meets AEE 1.259 or reproduces the PAFT-ep4 ~1.47-class failure.
uncertainties: Prior 1.47 number is PAFT-ep4 identity, not ep34

ideas.statement: Independent clock-gate of overlap, same_zero, and motion_xor popcounts when that term's support is empty.
predicted_observations: On the same packed Q/K, the fraction of tokens with overlap popcount exactly 0 is much larger than the fraction with same_zero popcount exactly 0 (ep35 overlap mean 0.013).
If the three terms share one fused popcount tree in SV, independent enables will not reduce leaf cycles.
uncertainties: ep34 term-zero histogram does not exist
datapath fusion in h67_motionxor_score_q7.sv uninspected for this claim
disconfirming_evidence: Software Q7 and the SV already skip empty terms, so RTL enable bits add no cycle delta

ideas.statement: Encoder feature-map temporal skip (CICC DLSS analog), explicitly not Motion-XOR score skip.
predicted_observations: Skip rate on encoder activations will not equal attention token skip rate on the same frames.
uncertainties: Feature-map traces for H67 encoder are not in the QK pack
disconfirming_evidence: Activation skip rate equals token skip rate, collapsing the claimed split from I001

assumptions.statement: Captured ATLIF outputs consumed by attention are binary {0,theta}.
Attention score leaf is a small fraction of ep34 cycles.
Shiftmax denominator is over a 15x15 window so token skip is not row skip.
assumptions.test_or_check: M2 align RTL row; ep35 preview window dirty 90.1 percent

assumptions.statement: Swapping one stage-2 block can be finetuned from ep34 without collapsing AEE past 1.259.
T=2 attention fibers and T=10 neuron fibers cannot share a uniform-T LoAS pack.
assumptions.test_or_check: Compare mixed-T versus uniform T=10 FTP on same FC2

assumptions.statement: CPU TSBG 3.89x serialized speedup will survive equal-resource RTL.
Prosperity copy can be the title contribution after local modifications.
Byte-write SRAM helps T x 15 x 15 Motion-XOR layout on foundry 1RW/2RW macros.
assumptions.test_or_check: Map FireFly-T permute onto TS1N28 macros

assumptions.statement: Running-BN inference can meet AEE 1.259 on ep34.
assumptions.test_or_check: Prior PAFT running-BN on a different checkpoint was 1.47

assumptions.statement: A term with popcount exactly zero can be clock-gated losslessly and independently of the other two Motion-XOR terms.
assumptions.test_or_check: Histogram exact-zero overlap/same_zero/motion on ep34; inspect SV fusion

assumptions.statement: Encoder feature-map temporal skip is a different co-design object from Motion-XOR token skip.
assumptions.test_or_check: Compare skip rates on the same frames for activations versus Q/K tokens

adversarial_reviews.strongest_version: Keep H67 Q7 formula; 32-lane leaf; K_peer t0 shadow; equal-resource vs AND-PopCount; no system FPS until T0.
adversarial_reviews.observation_against: T0 score-leaf share under about 2 percent and I003 one-block swap holds subset AEE.
alternatives: AND-PopCount plus a cheap extra XOR
editors read any popcount leaf as FireFly-T
adversarial_reviews.measurement_failure: ep35 census labeled ep34; leaf Hz as network FPS; omitting Q/K projection from attention share.
adversarial_reviews.sampling_or_generalizability_failure: 100-sample ep35 path; S3 vs S1 occupancy differs by ~15x.
adversarial_reviews.potential_harm_inequity_or_misuse: unpublished traces if leaked; no clinical harm
adversarial_reviews.mitigation: T0 first; name priors; isolate leaf benches; traces local
adversarial_reviews.response_owner_status: Accept T0 kill-switch. Owner P01. Open until M0.

adversarial_reviews.strongest_version: Lossless per-token enable when K is zero both T or Q/K equal t0; no 15x15 memo.
adversarial_reviews.observation_against: M2 denominator grain ~100 percent dirty (ep35 window dirty 90.1 percent, S3 clean 0).
adversarial_reviews.measurement_failure: token skip written as Shiftmax skip; 96 percent single-sample skip
adversarial_reviews.sampling_or_generalizability_failure: ep35 is not ep34; S1 empty would overstate skip without per-stage tables
adversarial_reviews.potential_harm_inequity_or_misuse: silent AEE regression if skip is approximate
adversarial_reviews.mitigation: merge into I001 as enable; lossless-only unless AEE gated
adversarial_reviews.response_owner_status: Merged into I001. Owner P02. Closed as title; open as M1/M2.

adversarial_reviews.strongest_version: Frozen-weight swap of one stage-2 block; 10-frame finetune only if AEE explodes.
adversarial_reviews.observation_against: Subset AEE moves toward 1.58 and stays after 10 frames.
adversarial_reviews.sampling_or_generalizability_failure: one sequence is not valid825; ImageNet is not DSEC
adversarial_reviews.mitigation: one block; subset first; stop if direction is up
adversarial_reviews.response_owner_status: Accept as cheapest algo probe. Owner P01. Optional parallel with M0.

adversarial_reviews.strongest_version: LoAS FTP is baseline; mixed-horizon packing plus bounded shared-sum; equal Y-port.
adversarial_reviews.observation_against: Equal-resource timeline vs FTP at most 1.00x, or reviewer writes LoAS plus ATLIF theta.
adversarial_reviews.measurement_failure: add reduction reported as cycle speedup; missing persist-Y
adversarial_reviews.mitigation: pre-declare mixed-T as the only novelty; M4 equal-resource
adversarial_reviews.residual_uncertainty: whether mixed-T is enough for TCAS-II
adversarial_reviews.response_owner_status: Contingent circuit face if T0 fails I001. Owner P01. Dormant until T0.

adversarial_reviews.strongest_version: Same-IO B8 vs LRU; cycle >=1.15x or <=5 percent slower with >=30 percent fewer weight bytes.
adversarial_reviews.observation_against: Equal-resource RTL under 1.15x, or reviewers reuse the unoriginal-broadcast judgment.
adversarial_reviews.sampling_or_generalizability_failure: frozen ep34 traces; new sparsity changes reuse
adversarial_reviews.response_owner_status: Comparator not title. Owner P01. M3 after M0 if resources exist.

adversarial_reviews.strongest_version: Membrane stays in-island; theta packet at BN boundary on real BN/PSN intervals.
adversarial_reviews.observation_against: Real intervals show recovery error that moves AEE, or reviewers cite Chen/Chang mixed-T 28nm.
adversarial_reviews.measurement_failure: synthetic TB intervals as online BN
adversarial_reviews.sampling_or_generalizability_failure: one BN group is not all stages
adversarial_reviews.mitigation: M7 real intervals; do not claim first mixed-T ASIC
adversarial_reviews.response_owner_status: Fifth/contingent. Owner P01. After M0 unless BN is critical path.

adversarial_reviews.strongest_version: Clock-gate each of three popcounts when that term's support is empty.
adversarial_reviews.observation_against: Q7 already short-circuits empty terms, or the three terms share one fused tree.
adversarial_reviews.measurement_failure: mean overlap 0.013 cited as 99 percent skip without a zero histogram
adversarial_reviews.mitigation: ep34 exact-zero histogram; then RTL enable bits
adversarial_reviews.response_owner_status: Hang on I001 as M1 add-on. Owner P02. Not a separate title.

support: No published temporal-peer K XOR popcount ASIC located in this search
Token skip is a known idea
challenges: Priors skip pixels or feature maps

support: Public linear and SDSA kernels exist to swap
Mixed T=2 vs T=10 is a local delta versus uniform-T LoAS
challenges: FTP inner-join is a strong prior

support: Broadcast reduces weight bytes on these CPU traces

challenges: Title novelty challenged by the prior itself
No complete Table-A in this repo

support: Running versus frozen BN split located locally
ep35 overlap mean 0.013 suggests overlap often empty
Feature-map temporal skip exists as a published 28nm OF idea

decision_log.decision: Advance I001 including I002 as one score-leaf object to measurement protocol M0-M2, with I012 as a census add-on. If T0 shows attention score leaf under about 2 percent, switch circuit-face work to I004. I003 is the cheapest algorithm-face probe. I005 remains a comparator not a title default. I007 stays fifth. Owner P01 may override.
decision_log.rationale: Orchestra Phase 3 requires one sharpened plan. I001 is algorithm-native, has RTL, and T1 already forbids dishonest skip claims. The numeric matrix is a decision aid only and its decision field remains null. Next action is simulation, not protocol development.
dissent: P03: I001 numeric lead is conditional on T0 and on XOR being accuracy-necessary.
uncertainties: T0 unmeasured
no ep34 QK pack
2 percent threshold is an assumed gate
single rater
same-model adversary
decision_log.revisit_when: ep34 T0 envelope available, or P01 files dissent, or I003 10-frame AEE exists, or 14 days after this log with no M0

notices: Ideas and scores are not evidence or scientific conclusions.
Clinical, ethics, biosafety, dual-use, regulatory, and institutional review remain separate.
Matrix decision is null; D001 is a facilitator-drafted next action pending P01.
